create.name: Amy Robeson
create.bio:
Amy Robeson is an American Akashic Records teacher, crystal worker and spiritual business mentor. She spent around a decade in a corporate career before leaving it in 2015 to teach the tools she had gathered since taking up yoga in 2008 and learning meditation from her first spiritual teacher. Her work now draws on the Akashic Records, crystalline energy, light language and spirit-guide connection, and she describes herself as an empath and intuitive.

She teaches almost entirely online. Her central programme, Sacred Awakening, is a live cohort training in opening and reading the Akashic Records for oneself and others, and she runs Soul Driven Success, a four-month group mentorship for practitioners turning intuitive gifts into a business. Shorter self-paced courses cover crystals and the chakras, animal spirit guides and the transpersonal chakras. She hosts the Awakening with Amy Robeson podcast, posts weekly videos on manifestation, intuition and the Records, and offers a free collection of recorded meditations and activations, alongside a monthly live crystal show on Facebook.

courses.title: Sacred Awakening Level 1
courses.description: A live online cohort that trains students to open and read the Akashic Records for themselves and for others, leading to her certification. Lessons move from first access through practice readings to applying guidance to everyday decisions.

courses.title: Soul Driven Success
courses.description: Four months of group mentorship for intuitive practitioners, such as Reiki and Records readers, who want to shape their skills into clear offers and a working practice. It mixes business planning with energetic clearings.

courses.title: Crystallization of Self
courses.description: A recorded chakra series that works through each energy centre with crystals and a crystal grid. Students follow it at their own pace.

courses.title: Meet Your Animal Spirit Guides Masterclass
courses.description: A recorded video lesson and guided activation on meeting and working with animal guides, with a bonus class linking them to the chakras. Access is for life.

courses.title: Star Activation Series
courses.description: A set of recorded activations focused on three transpersonal energy points she places beyond the body: the Soul Star above, the Earth Star below and a Star Seed point.

free_resources.title: Amy Robeson on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations and activations on the free Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Sacred Gifts Bundle
free_resources.description: A free library of more than twenty recorded meditations and energy activations, sent after signing up to her newsletter. Topics range from chakra balancing and moon rituals to manifesting.

free_resources.title: Discover Your Intuitive Superpower Quiz
free_resources.description: A two-minute quiz on how a person's intuition tends to work, followed by a short guided practice matched to the result.
